title: Inspect retained change history for an engineering subject
actor: A reviewer investigating a selected engineering subject
goal: Find attributable recorded decisions, findings and evidence across Changes concerning the selected subject.
context: Several retained Changes reference the same subject at different revisions.
trigger: The reviewer requests a bounded history selection.
preconditions: The actor explicitly identifies the project and intended scope.
Any requested mutation is subject to applicable project authority.

interaction.action: Selects a project-qualified subject and recorded-history filters.
Returns matching records with originating Changes, subject bases, selection scope and continuation or an explicit availability limitation.
Inspects selected detail or requests the next bounded selection.

expected_outcome: The reviewer can trace the selected recorded facts without reading unrelated history or treating historical assessment as current approval.

alternatives.condition: Available supported history has no matching records.
alternatives.outcome: The result is an empty complete selection for the declared scope, not a claim about unretained history.

failures.condition: History is missing, unreadable, unsupported or incompletely retained.
failures.outcome: The result reports the limitation rather than an empty complete history.

failures.condition: The selected history changes between result pages.
failures.outcome: Continuation conflicts and requires a fresh selection rather than omitting or duplicating work.

sources.basis: Draft derivation from the refined IRs and RR proposal; no approval, implementation or satisfaction claim.
